summary: Bit Digital, Inc. filed an 8-K reporting that its wholly-owned subsidiary entered into a $100M inter-company delayed draw term loan facility with an affiliate of WhiteFiber. The loan is for general corporate purposes, including completion of a HPC data center buildout in North Carolina. Terms include a 9.5% interest rate, 3% original issue discount, and a commitment fee. There is no special situation event; the filing discloses a routine debt arrangement.
